- Overestimate prices when sentiment is high (especially >0.75) — reduce forecast by 1–3% for high sentiment periods.
- Underestimate prices when sentiment is low (especially <0.3) — add 1–3% to forecast for low sentiment.
- Avoid sharp upward spikes in forecast after recent price increases — cap forecast growth at 2–4% above prior peak.
- Allow for mean reversion in 3–5 day horizons — if forecast is >10% above recent 7-day average, reduce by 5–10%.
- Correct for lagged sentiment effects — if sentiment dropped sharply 2–3 days prior, reduce forecast by 2–5%.
- For 30-day forecasts, avoid overconfidence in early periods — reduce forecast by 1–2% if sentiment is flat or declining.
